source.note: Layout: status (i16), severity (i16), RISC_pad (dbr_long_t, 4 bytes), value (dbr_double_t f64). The 4-byte RISC_pad aligns the f64 to an 8-byte boundary and is wire-only (a byte-identical degree of freedom), not a value-tree field. status=1, severity=2, pad=0x00000000, value=1.5=0x3FF8000000000000. Per epics-base modules/ca/src/client/db_access.h. Hand-authored anchor, machine-verified against real EPICS in 0c-3.
